description.zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

- zh：中文
- en：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English
The name of the Nacos instance.
Specifies whether to enable the service for the instance.
Specifies whether to mark the instance as a temporary node.
The IP address of the Nacos instance.
The node metadata of the instance.
The port number of the Nacos instance.

description.zh: 权重，为范围0～10000的整数。值越大，访问到该实例的频率越高。
description.en: The weight. Valid values: 0 to 10000. The value must be an integer. A larger value indicates a higher frequency at which the instance is accessed.

descriptions.zh: > 当前的OpenAPI并非是Nacos-SDK API，Nacos-SDK API相关内容，请参见[官方文档](https://nacos.io/zh-cn/docs/sdk.html)。
descriptions.en: > The operation is not provided in Nacos SDKs. For information about Nacos SDKs, see the [official documentation](https://nacos.io/zh-cn/docs/sdk.html).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse create-nacos-instance --instance-id mse-cn-123456 --service-name hello_service --group-name DEFAULT_GROUP --namespace-id 9e78a671-4b9b-4dd4-99c1-0b9da870000 --cluster-name DEFAULT --ip 1.2.xx.xx --port 12281 --ephemeral false --weight 1 --enabled true --metadata grayversion_:_1.0_,_preserved.register.source_:_SPRING_CLOUD_,_management.context-path_: --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
